hero.altText: A single marked step beside an unfinished path.

blocks.text: Mara returned to a half-finished report without a restart marker and spent ten minutes reconstructing what she meant to do next. A visible next step reduces restart friction.
A concrete next action can reduce the effort required to resume interrupted work.
She began ending each work block with one line: Leave a visible next step before you stop.
Write the next visible step and work on it for five minutes.

playbook.principle: A visible next step reduces restart friction.
playbook.whyItMatters: Leave a visible next step before you stop, so returning does not begin with another planning pass.

steps.title: Name the result
steps.body: State what the next small piece of progress should produce.

steps.title: Make it visible
steps.body: Put the next step where you will see it when you return.

steps.title: Start for five minutes
steps.body: Use the restart marker before deciding whether to continue longer.

example.title: A useful marker
example.body: Replace work on report with draft the first paragraph of the recommendation.

watchOuts: Do not write a vague category such as email or planning; name the visible next step.
